conclusions: Both native simulations converge without numerical warnings and preserve122OFF readbacks/all351devices.
Distributed-wire case has no measured clock crossings in2..4ns and violates unchanged0.4V VCE floor. This finite4ns experiment is not proof of permanent nonoscillation.

Actual local AVSS rise and independently measured passive rail R support real routing IR-drop as a contributor, distinct from passive clock attenuation. Relative causal contributions are not isolated by this two-case comparison.

Free-running clock and finite PRBS are not phase aligned; sampler data correctness is not qualified.

dc_paths.scope: One1mA injection0-to-terminal; Vref current is positive terminal-to-ground. Full32855R/16215C remain; all intrinsic devices absent only for passive driving-pointR. Open-load R is not shared-load transient R.

route_paths.meaning: Shortest actual R-edge path sum, not a substitute for native effectiveR when parallel paths exist. Rnodecoordinates are native5nm grid; no metal-layer inference from a missing report field.

actual_gds_widths.scope: Exact geometric cross-sections of identified rail/branch stretches; not a claim each extracted lump spans one metal or has no contact contribution.
